title: jaltomata herrerae
intro: Jaltomata herrerae, commonly known as the 'Night-Blooming Torch', is a species of flowering plant in the family Solanaceae. It is native to Mexico and is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects that help alleviate symptoms of fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Jaltomata herrerae include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antimicrobial agent, and expectorant, helping to clear mucus and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Jaltomata herrerae include glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and medicinal uses.
